proposed_from.topic: q-state double-triangular latent causal measurement identification via the explicit local-minor certificate Delta_DT: prove the determinant factorization, K_min(P_X)=K, and a terminating sound-and-complete same-K BLCM reconstruction algorithm A_q modulo coordinate/state relabeling and latent MEC; include the q=3 dense no-pure-child witness and CDM/cdmTools identifiability-check consumer
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The field-tier kernel starts where Lee and Gu's binary scalar contrast fails: for \(q\ge3\), it defines a novel categorical double-triangular condition, factors each \(q^K\)-view determinant into every context-specific \(q\times q\) minor, and proves an iff boundary. The Lee--Gu reduction is kept in a separately typed \(q_{\mathrm{bin}}=2\) domain with its exact published assumptions and conclusions, so no categorical symbol is specialized outside its declared space. An explicit diagonal-dominant family makes the numerator polynomial visibly nonzero on each fixed positive-table parameter space, giving a genuine relatively open dense full-measure locus. Chen et al. (2025) are the closest mixed-type comparator, but their completeness route and two sufficient measurements do not cover equal observed and latent support \(q\); their class is formally incomparable because it also admits continuous and non-triangular models. Beyond generic three-view uniqueness, the component-equality pattern identifies the product-coordinate map from \(q^K\) anonymous labels to \(K\) \(q\)-state coordinates and then the latent MEC. The rank identity makes \(K\) intrinsic and feeds fixed-dimension quotient identification over an explicitly enumerated BLCM alternative domain. The algorithmic advance remains honestly open: derive a terminating local-query procedure without pure items, larger-support measurements, completeness, or a mixture oracle.

seed_details.seed: Exact local-minor frontier for \(q\)-state triangular views
seed_details.anchor_read: The introduction, Theorems 1--2 and their proof sketches, the determinant induction in Appendix D, Appendix G, and the discussion were read. Appendix G, page 34, displays the ternary alternating polynomial and states that ordinary nondegeneracy no longer forces it to be nonzero.
seed_details.anchor_quote: Section 5, page 11: \emph{For the case of categorical latents, we conjecture that our sufficient identifiability conditions may be extended.}
seed_details.proof_boundary: Replace the binary scalar contrast in the Schur-complement induction by a context-indexed \(q\times q\) conditional table and retain its determinant at every recursive step.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the pair \(\{\text{categorical double triangularity},\text{local determinant factorization}\}\) returned no closer theorem than Lee and Gu's Appendix G and generic Kruskal results.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Lee and Gu because Appendix G already writes the required categorical condition.
seed_details.rebuttal: Appendix G gives only the \(q=3,K=2\) obstruction and a generic-condition remark; it does not index all predecessor contexts, factor the \(q^K\)-determinant, or prove necessity.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is not a generic-rank restatement: the named focal object is the explicit polynomial \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}\), and both directions include its zero boundary.
seed_details.burned_reason: The local-minor frontier was maximized through D0, but reaching field would require a calibrated finite-sample procedure, implementation, complexity analysis, or reproducible computational demonstration rather than another in-scope revision.

seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 2's three-view Kruskal construction, Appendix E.2's implemented penalized-EM pipeline, and the discussion of computational difficulty were read alongside Gu's constructive unfolding proof.
seed_details.anchor_quote: Appendix E.2, page 29: \emph{While our identifiability results naturally lead to an algorithm, its practical implementation is challenging.}
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is to replace the nonconstructive rank-\(2^K\) CP call by recursive view discovery and component alignment driven by observable ranks and the local minors exposed by \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}\).
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the pair \(\{\text{no-pure-child categorical measurement graph},\text{complete rank-query algorithm}\}\) found Gu's pure-item unfolding algorithm and Kivva et al.'s mixture-oracle algorithm, but no same-\(K\) complete procedure in the target class.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Gu's exhaustive tensor-unfolding recovery algorithm.
seed_details.rebuttal: Gu's iff rank queries start by locating two pure items per attribute, whereas the target class permits a coordinate with no pure child and therefore requires a different first partitioning certificate.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The open question has a concrete recursive local-minor and unfolding handle, an explicit termination measure, and exact soundness and completeness targets.

seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 1 and equation (3) were read; their two-view marginal has rank \(2^K\) and rules out arbitrary alternatives with fewer binary coordinates.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is to insert the categorical factorization theorem before applying \(\operatorname{rank}(M_1\operatorname{diag}(\pi)M_2^{\mathsf T})=q^K\).
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for \(K_{\min}(P_X)\) under \(q\)-state measurement models found only Kivva et al.'s recovery from a supplied mixture oracle and Allman et al.'s known-component Kruskal theory.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by replacing \(2^K\) with \(q^K\) in Lee and Gu's rank argument.
seed_details.rebuttal: That replacement is valid only after the new exact local-minor factorization; Appendix G supplies positive nondegenerate cases where the proposed replacement fails without \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}\neq0\).
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The alternative class is not assumed double triangular and does not receive a mixture oracle.

seed_details.anchor_read: The no-pure-child example in Figure 1 and the determinant-vanishing ternary examples in Appendix G were read.
seed_details.proof_boundary: Choose two triangular orders with different first coordinates, add incomparable mixed children for the remaining coordinate, and use rational contrast weights whose local determinants can be evaluated exactly.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for an explicit positive \(q=3,K=3\) double-triangular witness without a pure child found no published construction.
seed_details.red_team: A single hand-tuned witness is mathematically decorative.
seed_details.rebuttal: The witness is paired with the strict inequality \(\min_{a,k,u}|d_{a,k,u}|>0\), which gives a relatively open certified neighborhood and demonstrates nonvacuity beyond one law.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The theorem states the open-neighborhood consequence, not merely one numerical instance.
seed_details.disposition: dropped as standalone; retained as a supporting proposition

seed_details.seed: Calibrated empirical certificate for cognitive diagnosis
seed_details.anchor_read: The publisher's abstract and article conclusion summary were opened, and the supplementary proof of Theorem 1 was read. The paper constructs consistency statistics for a provisional \(Q\)-matrix and derives their null limits despite the large response-pattern table; Gu's 2026 discussion separately calls for singular-value surrogates for population unfolding ranks.
seed_details.proof_boundary: Replace provisional \(Q\)-matrix residuals by the simultaneous vector of empirical local determinants and smallest singular values queried by the population reconstruction handle.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for \(\{\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}},\text{calibrated identifiability test}\}\) found only the binary structural check implemented by \(\texttt{cdmTools}\) and no sampling theory for the new certificate.
seed_details.red_team: A delta-method test for determinants is routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nonroutine object is uniform simultaneous validity across adaptively selected rank and minor queries near intersecting determinantal varieties; the core leaves that rung open.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: No limit law is assumed, and the empirical rung is not presented as already solved.
seed_details.disposition: dropped as kernel; retained as an open consumer rung

seed_details.anchor_read: Appendix G was read for its statement that a categorical latent with \(q\) states requires at least \(q\) observed categories for the square determinant argument.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is to optimize over \(q\)-row submatrices of each rectangular observed-by-latent conditional table before executing triangular elimination.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for local minor selection in rectangular categorical double-triangular blocks found generic Kruskal rank criteria but no graph-indexed iff certificate.
seed_details.red_team: Cauchy--Binet makes this a routine corollary.
seed_details.rebuttal: Cauchy--Binet proves existence of some nonzero minor after full rank is known; it does not produce compatible, observable row selections across all predecessor contexts.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The target would require a coherent selection rule, not an unspecified maximum over minors.

seed_details.anchor_read: The introduction, Assumptions 2.2--2.4, mixture-oracle Definition 2.5, Theorems 3.2 and 4.2, and the discussion were read; latent state-space sizes are recovered from mixture orders supplied by the oracle.
seed_details.proof_boundary: Replace the uniform recursion size \(q) by mixed-radix blocks of sizes \(q_k\), then determine whether the local determinant exponents remain multiplicative under distinct triangular orders.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for mixed-cardinality double-triangular local certificates found no direct theorem, but the target requires substantial notation and is less aligned with the fixed-\(q\) brief.
seed_details.red_team: This is a mechanical mixed-radix rewrite of the fixed-\(q\) proof.
seed_details.rebuttal: Different local row selections and cross-view state alignment create a real compatibility problem, but it should follow rather than lead the fixed-\(q\) paper.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Deferred because a routine-looking generality extension would obscure the exact fixed-\(q\) frontier.

seed_details.seed: State orientation without the subset condition
seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 4's necessity of the subset condition and Proposition 1's monotonicity replacement were read.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is to replace binary sign-flip orientation by an order-restricted alignment of \(q\) state labels across tensor components.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for ordered-state alignment in categorical no-pure-child measurement models found monotone cognitive-diagnosis restrictions but no exact replacement of the subset condition in this graph class.
seed_details.red_team: This is the obvious \(q\)-state analogue of Lee and Gu's monotonicity proposition.
seed_details.rebuttal: A total order can orient within-coordinate labels but does not by itself separate nested child sets, so the result needs a new alignment argument and is too uncertain for the present kernel.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The candidate is rejected rather than hiding the unresolved nested-column obstruction in an assumption.
